about: Display names for the GAB leaderboard. system = the name of the thing being benchmarked (STTM Desktop Voice-Follow); change it here and republish (gab publish --site-only). builds: 8-character commit -> label (shown after the system name) and kind (release = a version that went into the app; experiment = a change tested here, not in the app; older version = a milestone before the first 9.0.1 release, kept so the colours have context). why = a short muted line under the name on the Space: what that version was merged for. type = change-type chips shown in the dropdown (Accuracy, Speed, Slow PCs, Panel/UI, Infrastructure, New behaviour). A build missing here gets '<system> <Voice-Follow version> · <--name>'. 'In the app now' is worked out on the page: the latest release by --order.
